annotations.title: Approve a content kit and start its draft write

description: Approve a reviewed kit at expected_kit_revision with the user's explicit consent. Agent decisions are recorded as decided_by=agent. The held generation covers one article write with no additional allowance charge. A started write runs as a separate job on the item. write=started includes an already running write. write=not_started records approval without starting a write. With write_state=owes_write, a user-authorized reapproval can retry a failed write. Each held generation allows three started attempts total. A failed dispatch can reuse its attempt. A 409 item_not_generatable records nothing. Idempotency-Key is unsupported.

body.description: Approve or reject the kit at this revision (request).
body.title: PublicKitDecisionInput

name: approve_content_kit

anyOf.description: The approved kit plus what happened to the article write.

items.description:
One citable claim. ``origin=supplied`` is a fact you supplied; its
``url`` is set only when its page was fetched and states the fact.
``supplied_url`` and ``source_check`` show the URL you supplied and why
it is or is not cited.

origin.description: Who supplied a cited source of a v2 article (public ``origin``).
origin.title: ArticleSourceOrigin

section_ids.description: Outline section ids this claim supports, if mapped.
section_ids.title: Section Ids

anyOf.description:
What checking a supplied fact's source URL found. Only a verified URL
is cited.
anyOf.title: FactSourceOutcome

source_check.description: What checking the supplied URL found: verified (cited), fetch_failed (the page could not be read), not_on_page (the page does not state every figure and name in the fact), ineligible_url or unsafe_url (not allowed), or removed_source (the source was removed or its domain excluded). Null on facts added before it was recorded.

anyOf.description: A sanitized diagnostic. An HTTP status is present only when observed.

reason.description: Observed reason a source read failed to yield a page for verification.
reason.title: FactFetchFailureReason

anyOf.title: FactFetchFailure

source_check_failure.description: Recorded detail of a failed source read. Null when no detail was recorded.

supplied_url.description: The source URL you supplied with this fact, kept even when it is not cited. Null on facts added before it was recorded.
supplied_url.title: Supplied Url

items.title: PublicKitClaim

items.description:
One article component (FAQ, stats, quotes, table, takeaways, sources).
``locked`` and ``user_override`` components are kept as you set them.
items.title: PublicKitComponent

anyOf.description:
Who decided the kit's current status: the approval gate, a user, or
an agent (OAuth) acting for a user.
anyOf.title: ContentKitDecisionActor

anyOf.description:
What evidence the kit holds now. Computed from the current kit on
every read and write, so it reflects your edits; ``review_findings`` is
the review gate's record of an earlier revision.

min_sources.description: The brief's minimum, set only when it requires citations.
min_sources.title: Min Sources

items.description: One outline section's evidence in the current kit.

claim_count.description: Cited claims matched to this section.
claim_count.title: Claim Count

general_only.description: The writer keeps this section general: no figures, prices, dates or named-product facts.
general_only.title: General Only

source_urls.description: Distinct URLs cited in this section.
source_urls.title: Source Urls

uncited_claim_ids.description: Facts you supplied for this section that have no cited URL; they are written as plain prose.
uncited_claim_ids.title: Uncited Claim Ids

items.title: PublicKitSectionEvidence

unmapped_claim_count.description: Claims not matched to a section, such as facts you supplied.
unmapped_claim_count.title: Unmapped Claim Count

items.description:
A kit element or citation rule the brief requires that the current
kit cannot provide.

element.description: The article elements a spec can require, allow or turn off.
element.title: ArticleElement

reason.description: Why a brief-required element is missing from the kit.
reason.title: RequiredElementReason

items.title: PublicKitUnmetRequirement

unplaceable_claim_ids.description: Facts you supplied, and must-use claims, that no section can state because every section they could appear in is general-only. Add supplied facts with section_ids to place them.
unplaceable_claim_ids.title: Unplaceable Claim Ids

anyOf.title: PublicKitEvidence

items.description: One planned section of the article.
items.title: PublicKitOutlineItem

review_findings.description: What the review gate found. Each item is one of: a low-confidence requirement or claim (item_id, kind, confidence, threshold, reason); a component that failed verification (component_id, kind, reason, claim_id); a kit element or citation rule the brief's article spec requires that the kit cannot provide (element, reason, detail; approving the kit waives it); or an article spec note that never holds the kit (advisory, element, component_id).
review_findings.title: Review Findings

write.description:
What happened to the article write after an approval was stored.

``started``: the write for this approved kit is running (poll
``GET /jobs`` filtered by ``content_item_id``). ``not_started``: the
approval is stored but no write started; approve again or regenerate.
write.title: PublicKitWriteStatus

anyOf.title: PublicKitApproval
